description: This Java source file defines a utility class `ConnectionMigrationUtil` responsible for migrating persisted `Connection` JSON objects to the current structure, including handling deprecated fields and formats. It includes nested classes for specific migration steps such as source filters, topic-action substitutions, and authorization context adjustments.

classes.name: ConnectionMigrationUtil
classes.description: Final utility class for migrating connection JSON objects, with nested classes handling specific migration steps.

classes.name: ConnectionMigrationUtil.MigrateSourceFilters
classes.description: Handles migration of source filter fields to enforcement structures.

classes.name: ConnectionMigrationUtil.MigrateTopicActionSubjectFilters
classes.description: Handles transformation of topic:action|subject placeholders to a new format within connection documents.

classes.name: ConnectionMigrationUtil.MigrateAuthorizationContexts
classes.description: Merges global authorization contexts into individual source and target authorization fields during migration.

methods.name: connectionFromJsonWithMigration
methods.description: Main method that applies all migration steps on a given JSON object to produce a Connection instance.
